# Bundled ONNX Runtime

`ort.wasm.min.js`, `ort-wasm-simd-threaded.mjs` and `ort-wasm-simd-threaded.wasm` come from `onnxruntime-web` 1.30.0 (MIT License, © Microsoft Corporation; https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime). Kotoba uses them to run the PaddleOCR and manga-ocr models. They are loaded from the extension's own URL.
